'''William Russel Buck''' (born December 27, 1950) is an American [[Bryology|bryologist]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=William R. Buck » New York Botanical Garden|url=https://www.nybg.org/person/william-buck/|access-date=2021-10-23|website=New York Botanical Garden|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=William Russel Buck|url=https://www.nybg.org/bsci/staf/buck.html|access-date=2021-10-23|website=www.nybg.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last=Buck|first=William R.|date=1996|title=Bryology at The New York Botanical Garden, Past and Present|url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2807805|journal=Brittonia|volume=48|issue=3|pages=399–403|issn=0007-196X}}</ref>

{{Botanist|W.R.Buck|inline=yes}}

Buck received both his [[Bachelor's degree|Bachelor's]] and [[Master's degree|Master's]] degrees at the [[University of Florida]], in 1972 and 1974, respectively.  In 1979, he completed his PhD at the [[University of Michigan]] in [[Ann Arbor]].

Since 1979, Buck has worked at the [[New York Botanical Garden]].  He became the curator for bryophytes in 1986, and senior curator in 2000.  Since 1986, he has also been an adjunct professor at the [[City University of New York]].

== Publications ==
* {{aut|Buck, W. R.}}, {{aut|Vitt, D. H.}} (1986) ''Suggestions for a new familial classification of pleurocarpous mosses''. Taxon 35 (1): 21–60.
* {{aut|Buck, W. R.}}, {{aut|Goffinet, B.}} (2000) ''Morphology and classification of mosses''. pp.&nbsp;71–123 ''in'' Shaw, A. J. & B. Goffinet (eds.) ''Bryophyte Biology'', 1st ed.  Cambridge University Press. ISBN 0-521-66097-1
* {{aut|Buck, W. R.}}, {{aut|Cox, C. J.}}, {{aut|Shaw, J.}}, {{aut|Goffinet, B.}} (2004) ''Ordinal relationships of pleurocarpous mosses, with special emphasis on the Hookeriales''. Systematics and Biodiversity 2: 121–145.
* {{aut|Goffinet, B.}}, {{aut|Buck, W. R.}} (2004) ''Systematics of the Bryophyta (Mosses): From molecules to a revised classification''. Monographs in Systematic Botany [Molecular Systematics of Bryophytes] 98: 205–239. ISBN 1-930723-38-5
* {{aut|Goffinet, B.}}, {{aut|Buck, W. R.}}, {{aut|Shaw, A. J.}} (2008) ''Morphology and Classification of the Bryophyta''. pp.&nbsp;55–138 ''in'' Goffinet, B. & J. Shaw (eds.) ''Bryophyte Biology'', 2nd ed.  Cambridge University Press. 
* {{aut|Goffinet, B.}}, {{aut|Buck, W. R.}}, {{aut|Shaw, A. J.}} (2012) [http://bryology.uconn.edu/classification/ Classification of the Bryophyta] (efter Goffinet, Buck, & Shaw, 2008)

He edited the [[exsiccata]] ''Bryophytorum Typorum Exsiccata'' (1981-1985), distributed by The New York Botanical Garden.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bryophytorum Typorum Exsiccata: IndExs ExsiccataID=2073781247 |website=IndExs – Index of Exsiccatae |publisher=Botanische Staatssammlung München |url=https://www.botanischestaatssammlung.de/DatabaseClients/IndExs/Exsiccatae_IndExs_Details.jsp?ExsiccataID=2073781247 |access-date=17 July 2024}}</ref>
